risks: Configuration changes can shift load to dependencies or interrupt requests; assess capacity and consistency first.
verification_steps: Compare the cited causal signal, service error rate, latency and downstream health against the pre-change baseline during the canary window.
rollback: If health deteriorates or the causal signal fails to recover, stop rollout and restore the captured approved configuration or routing state.
